text_block_list.text:
One morning, I see a large pile of
cardboard
boxes in front of the school
dormitories.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Most likely they were supposed to be
delivered
to the academy, but wound up
here instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh! I've never seen so much stuff
before!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: My arms are itching to pick it all up!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Without a moment's hesitation, Winning
Ticket
tries to lift one of the boxes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Stop right there, Ticket. Are you
seriously going
to carry all of those?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This'll be a cinch for us! Piece of
carrot
cake!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Uh... no way. I just did some quick
calculations
and there's no way we'll be
able to make it by the
first bell.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so there's a time limit to this race,
huh? That
makes it even better!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит grabs a box and runs off.

Moments later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Done! Okay, next round! Staaart!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh? She's 5.8 seconds faster than I
predicted. Are
you going to break your
limit, Ticket?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You bet! I'm gonna be even faster this
time!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
...Curious. I shall see if I, too, can surpass
my
limit.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Not only Бива Хаяхидэ, but a steady
stream of
other students begin taking
boxes as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! You'll never beat meeeee!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
A crowd runs back and forth between
the
dormitories and the academy. Within
minutes, the
number of boxes dwindles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Here comes the last ooone!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
That was a great morning workout! I'm
not sure
who got first, though!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
One thing's for sure—it seems like we all
broke
through our limits.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone's efforts, the
problem is
resolved quickly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
